articles.author: Ilyas Abdisalam
articles.description:
This tutorial will show you how to deploy a simple Node.js (Express) app to Vercel. It’s perfect for beginners who want to get their API online fast — without worrying about infrastructure.
Before you start, make sure you have the following installed:
✅ Node.js and npm on your system

✅ Git installed

✅ GitHub account

✅ Basic knowledge of JavaScript and Node.js
Open your terminal and run the following commands:
mkdir my-app
cd my-app
npm init -y
npm install express

This creates a new folder, initializes a Node.js project, and installs Express.js.
Inside your project folder, create a file called index.js and add the following code:
const express = require('express');
const app = express();

app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  res.send('Hello, Vercel!');
});

app.listen(3000, () => {
  console.log('Server is running on http://localhost:3000');
});

This sets up a basic Express server that responds with "Hello, Vercel!".
Run the app locally to make sure everything works:
node index.js

Visit http://localhost:3000 in your browser — you should see:
Hello, Vercel!
Create a .gitignore file and ignore node_modules:




echo node_modules > .gitignore

Initialize a git repository and push it to GitHub:




git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO_NAME.git
git push -u origin main

Go to https://vercel.com and sign in with your GitHub account.
Click "New Project".
Import your repository.
Leave all settings as default and click "Deploy".
Wait a few moments… and voilà! Your Node.js app is live ✨
You’ve just built and deployed a Node.js app to the web using Express            and Vercel. From here, you can:
Build APIs and connect to databases
Add frontend frameworks like React or Vue
articles.title: How to Deploy a Node.js App to Vercel

What is SEO?
SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the process of improving a website or web page so that it ranks higher on search engines like Google, Bing, or Yahoo — helping more people find it organically (without paid ads).
Simple Words To Understand :
SEO helps your content appear at the top when someone searches for related topics online.


So now you  have some idea about what is Search engine Optimization.



How Does SEO Work?
Eg:
Imagine the internet as a huge library and Google as the librarian.
“What is LGBTQ ?”
SEO is the method that helps your page be one of those top results.
SEO Works in 3 Main Steps:
1. Crawling :
They collect content from every website to understand what it's about
2. Indexing :
It organizes it based on topics, keywords, relevance, and structure
3. Ranking :
When a user searches, Google finds the most relevant results from its            index and ranks them
Ranking depends on many signals like:
     -> Keywords used

     -> Page quality and structure

     -> Website speed

     -> Mobile-friendliness

    -> Backlinks (other sites linking to yours)

My Opinion :
After hearing this i may interested on it . moreover what i give here is just a beginning line . you can search more about it like ,** What are the types of SEO, What’s the difference between SEO and paid ads (SEM)?, What happens if a website has no SEO? ,What is the main goal of SEO? . so there are multiple questions About SEO **, so find it and improve your Skills...
Conclusion :
SEO helps your content get found on search engines like Google. By using the right keywords, writing clearly, and improving your page, you can reach more people. It’s a smart skill for anyone who creates online content. Start small, keep learning, and grow step by step. 
Quotes Time :
"You don’t need to be an expert to start — you just need to start to become one."
